label: extension

args.subject: Group booking enquiry: availability for 10 people in June
args.body:
Hello,

I am organising a group stay at City Hub Tokyo and would like to ask about availability for 10 people in June. Could you please let me know which dates are available, the group rates, and any booking conditions?

Thank you, and I look forward to your reply.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech

final_text:
I emailed groups@cityhub-tokyo.jp, the group-bookings address in one of City Hub's guest reviews. The hotel is listed as "City Hub" in Tokyo.

The email asks about availability for 10 people in June, group rates and booking conditions. I didn't include specific dates because you haven't given any. It's signed from you at Blue Sparrow Tech, and replies will go to your inbox.
